Brewing Excellence with The Coffee Academïcs 帶來非凡咖啡體驗

Freshly brewed coffee above the clouds — enjoy our new bespoke coffee blend, created in collaboration with award-winning roaster The Coffee Academïcs ☕. Introducing the Cathay Blend by The Coffee Academïcs, a unique blend carefully crafted for discerning palates at high altitudes. With harmonising notes of dark cocoa, roasted almonds, and a hint of floral honey aroma, our blend ensures a flavourful experience in the skies ✈️. The Cathay blend is now available in our Premium Economy and Economy cabins. We’ll continue to bring the best of Hong Kong to the air through thoughtful collaborations with quality local brands. The difference is in the detail ✨. Learn more: https://bit.ly/45DzXpo #cathaypacific #MoveBeyond 有甚麼比得上在高空中 ，享受一杯新鮮沖泡的香濃咖啡更悠然自得? 我們與得獎精品咖啡品牌 The Coffee Academïcs 聯手打造的全新混調咖啡 ☕，現已登陸經濟客艙及特選經濟客艙！ 全新的咖啡配方融合了黑可可和烘烤杏仁的細緻層次，再配以花蜜的香氣，讓你在萬呎高空亦能品嚐香醇豐富的口感 ✈️。 細節心思，造就不凡 ✨。我們將繼續與更多優質的本地品牌合作，將城中最好的出品帶到空中！了解更多︰https://bit.ly/4mHw6OX #國泰航空 #志在飛躍
